name: @overlay-one/cli
description: Move files in and out of your Overlay brain, and search it, from a terminal.

scripts.smoke: node dist/overlay.js --help >/dev/null && node dist/overlay.js search --help >/dev/null && node dist/overlay.js prompt --help >/dev/null && node dist/overlay.js prompt list --help >/dev/null && node dist/overlay.js --help | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>process.exit(s.includes(String.fromCharCode(27))?1:0))" && echo smoke-ok
